name: HTTP Headers
description: Configure HTTP headers dynamically for API requests

properties.name: headers
properties.description: Define HTTP headers to include in the request. Common headers: Content-Type, Authorization, Accept, User-Agent.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The name of the HTTP header (e.g., Content-Type, Authorization)

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value for this header. Can use {{data.field}} to reference input data

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Whether to include this header in the request
